records.governing_sense_or_question: Who may testify to personhood, violence, land, conversion, and good government inside an archive produced by conquest?
records.pivot: moral-political standing relative to speaker, archive, address, and coercive encounter

factors.role: documents injury and proposes judgment through a constrained addressee
factors.variation: Guaman Poma's visual-textual, Christian-Andean address is neither transparent Indigenous voice nor Spanish doctrine

factors.role: frames whether Indigenous peoples possess reason, sovereignty, property, and protection
factors.variation: Las Casas and Sepúlveda use rival knowledge and natural-law arguments

factors.role: contrasts accountable rule with colonial extraction, violence, and corrupt office
factors.variation: petition, critique, and proposed hierarchy coexist

dependencies: standing claims depend on whose knowledge is credited
archival survival depends on colonial institutions and address
constraints: European disputants do not own Indigenous position
description does not certify conversion, Crown authority, land title, or law
records.interpretive_status: source-supported conquest-archive contrast with Indigenous custody debt

records.governing_sense_or_question: Can a situated American philosophy become intellectually independent without turning mixture, nation, or authenticity into a new assimilating essence?
records.pivot: intellectual identity relative to dependence, situated practice, and national-racial synthesis

factors.role: centers situated peoples, histories, education, and government against imitation
factors.variation: continental solidarity and national rhetoric retain exclusions

factors.role: projects synthesis as civilizational identity and future
factors.variation: can erase Black and Indigenous peoples, coercion, hierarchy, and nonmixture

factors.role: evaluates thought by its relation to material and cultural subordination
factors.variation: negative authenticity diagnosis can erase existing critical work

dependencies: intellectual dependence relates to political economy and institutions
identity synthesis depends on who may refuse assimilation
constraints: Latin American is not Hispanic or mestizo essence
authenticity is not purity from external influence
records.interpretive_status: source-supported identity/authenticity dispute with assimilation conflict

records.governing_sense_or_question: How can philosophy begin from excluded others and move from material harm through valid collective judgment to feasible transformation?
records.pivot: normative claim relative to exteriority, dependence, and liberation praxis

factors.role: locates the excluded other's interruption of a self-enclosed system
factors.variation: Levinasian, Marxian, theological, and geopolitical registers interact

factors.role: begins dialogue from the other's word beyond dialectical totalization
factors.variation: method and metaphysical grounding are disputed

factors.role: joins material reproduction, participation, feasibility, critique, and transformation
factors.variation: class, gender, religion, nation, ecology, and means create internal conflicts

dependencies: validity without material life or feasibility is insufficient
praxis depends on accountable participation by affected people
constraints: no theology, revolutionary means, or policy becomes guidance
records.interpretive_status: source-supported liberation family with normative and gender conflict

records.governing_sense_or_question: How do modern institutions continue colonial classifications, and how can border knowledge pluralize worlds without becoming another total system?
records.pivot: knowledge and identity relative to colonial power, location, and concrete practice

factors.role: links racial classification, labor, authority, subjectivity, and knowledge after formal colonialism
factors.variation: macro pattern needs concrete mechanism and historical heterogeneity

factors.role: reasons from colonial difference rather than a universal center
factors.variation: border location is epistemic-political, not geographic metadata

factors.role: permits interacting worlds without one universal epistemic sovereign
factors.variation: plurality still needs conflict, translation, and accountability

dependencies: coloniality claims require named subjects, institutions, practices, and mechanisms
pluriversality depends on noncoercive relation and dissent
constraints: decolonial thought is not one Latin American doctrine
macro diagnosis is not causal proof or universal prescription
records.interpretive_status: source-supported decolonial family with abstraction and gender criticism

records.governing_sense_or_question: How do race, gender, sexuality, class, colonial institutions, and standpoint co-produce whose humanity and knowledge become authoritative?
records.pivot: category and coalition relative to colonial power and embodied standpoint

factors.role: tracks co-production of gender, race, sexuality, labor, and human classification
factors.variation: light/dark side formulation and precolonial gender histories are debated

factors.role: recenters Black and Indigenous formation across the Americas against Hispanic Latin default
factors.variation: diaspora, language, nation, class, and gender remain nonidentical

factors.role: joins standpoint, movement practice, anti-racism, anti-sexism, class, and democratic struggle
factors.variation: not one program or representative voice

dependencies: category effects depend on institution, body, labor, language, and colonial history
coalition depends on difference and accountable political practice
constraints: Latin American feminism is internally plural
gender critique cannot erase current violence, Indigenous sovereignty, or Black specificity
records.interpretive_status: source-supported feminist/Afro-Latin counter-frame with Indigenous scope debt

records.governing_sense_or_question: How can persons and cultures form through forced encounter and relation while retaining opacity and transforming inherited genres of the human?
records.pivot: identity relative to relation, unpredictable mixture, and limits on transparent knowledge

factors.role: constitutes identity through open, non-rooted encounter across histories and places
factors.variation: not a generic edge or symmetric association

factors.role: names unpredictable transformation through contact rather than additive mixture
factors.variation: plantation violence and linguistic-cultural creativity remain together

factors.role: limits demands that another become fully transparent within the knower's categories
factors.variation: not secrecy, missing data, or immunity from accountability

dependencies: relation and creolization arise within slavery, plantation, migration, and archipelagic history
Wynterian sociogeny challenges inherited genres of Man as the human endpoint
constraints: Caribbean is multilingual and internally plural
opacity cannot excuse harm or block accountable claims
alternative_factorings: Wynter sociogeny and genres of Man
Césaire/Fanon anti-colonial critique omitted from the frozen source floor
records.interpretive_status: source-supported Caribbean contrast with major linguistic and thinker debt
